properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.operation-log.schema-validation
properties.description: Whether to check at startup that the operation-log table exists and carries the columns of the latest migration. 'validate' fails fast; 'none' disables.

properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.operation-log.cleanup.enabled
properties.description: Whether to schedule the operation-log cleanup. Off by default: discarding audit records is a statement, never a default.

properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.operation-log.cleanup.retention-seconds
properties.description: How long a business audit record is kept (365 days).

properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.operation-log.cleanup.batch-size
properties.description: Rows per time-sliced delete page. Many small transactions instead of one giant first purge.
